Manifest.VersionInfoText:
RFiDGear 2.0.5.0
New: - Pre-quick-check key dialog: configure DESFire and MIFARE Classic keys before every quick check, with a "Do not ask again" option - Default Keys tab in Settings: edit and validate quick-check keys with live green/red feedback - "Check for Updates" now shows a confirmation when already on the latest version
Fixed: - #181: AppExistCheck task incorrectly reported success even when the specified application ID did not exist on the card - #180: DESFire WriteData returning false success on Elatec provider - #179: Key settings changeover operations not reachable via task dialog - #178: ChangeKey used wrong XOR payload for non-master key changes (LibLogicalAccess) - #176: Create Application retried without PICC auth for cards configured with Create/Delete-without-MK - #175: DESFire app settings not displayed when card requires unauthenticated fallback (partial fix) - LibLogicalAccess: file access-rights byte order mismatch; missing file size in GetFileSettings; application list accumulating across repeated quick-check runs; DESFire key SWIG copy trap causing authentication failures - Elatec provider: COM port access serialised to prevent concurrent-access errors - Settings window no longer grows to extreme width when many MIFARE Classic keys are loaded
